brief_rationale: The trajectory successfully completed all responsibility-chain requirements without any in-chain errors. The doctor screened for obstetric red flags, provided correct levothyroxine safety guidance, recognized the high-risk obstetric context, maintained appropriate uncertainty about fetal hydrocephalus, delivered an executable plan with teach-back, and grounded responses in available records. Four high-order points were triggered and completed with meaningful trajectory impact: correcting family misconceptions about prenatal testing (HO1), discovering the hidden state of the hypothyroidism diagnosis (HO2), verifying the ambiguous fetal hydrocephalus report (HO3), and navigating real-world constraints by designing an executable consolidated visit plan (HO4). Closure is valid with confirmed family understanding.
